open_obligations.detail: Establish the linear projection gain for k-1<=q<=k-1/2<t<k, including the q=k-1 plate hypothesis, and its measurable power-small bad-direction consequence.

Construct separated (d/2+chi)-Frostman original laws and decreasing positive-mass Borel filters with controlled product partitions and simultaneous unnormalized original-fiber cap estimates after power-small deletion; justify the odd-dimensional upgrade.

Prove the weighted shell conversion with exact model-mass normalization, separated support, support-preserving differentiated symbols, arbitrary-power errors and derivative budgets fixed independently of N.

Establish oscillatory localization and both graph degrees under the stated depth and support-test hypotheses, retaining the endpoint symbols and the min-of-two-profile-cost exponent without a separation requirement on independent-energy cells.

Verify suffix full-conditional transfer, low-shell absence of fixed sigma loss, exact inherited test availability, timing of reached-factor deletion, far stationary support and normalization, and terminal/low-frequency bounds.

Construct finite uniform shape-wise numerical envelopes, treating zero energies and unrealized shapes, polynomial child sums, symbol suprema without an assumed maximizing symbol, and additive errors. Choose T above the ancestor-factor budget, fix persistent inverse-expansion orders, then direct and nonstationary orders before taking N large.
